items.title: Merck Stock Ran On A Checklist Published In Advance
items.summary: The products meant to offset the KEYTRUDA patent expiry were named, and two were already booking revenue, before the stock moved.

items.title: Pfizer Stock Is A Race Between New Drugs And Old Patents
items.summary: The medicines Pfizer has launched and acquired are arriving at close to the scale of the revenue its expiring patents will take away.

items.title: Dividend Giants Pfizer, Chevron, AbbVie: Bold 2027 Price Targets Ahead
items.summary: Pfizer, Chevron, and AbbVie have already rewarded dividend investors with strong 2026 gains, but the bull case for 2027 pushes well beyond what Wall Street consensus currently projects, and the catalysts behind each target may surprise you.

items.title: GKOS Stock Surges 67% Year to Date: What's Driving the Rally?
items.summary: Glaukos' iDose TR momentum and Epioxa launch are driving record growth, higher 2026 guidance and a broader ophthalmology platform.

items.title: Can IART's SurgiMend Relaunch Help Drive a Broader 2027 Recovery?
items.summary: Integra's SurgiMend relaunch could support a broader 2027 recovery, but customer recapture and FDA approval remain key to the upside.

items.title: Why Is Merck Stock Still Undervalued After An 80% Surge?
items.summary: You do not expect a pharmaceutical giant with a $376 billion market cap to put up numbers that make growth investors blush. Yet over the last 12 months, Merck (MRK) handed investors an 80% return, lapping the S&P 500. The apex occurred yesterday, August 19, 2026, when the stock surged to all-time highs.

items.title: Johnson & Johnson Stock Runs On A Calendar The Market Does Not Set
items.summary: The stock has stood out while the index has barely moved, but the number that matters for a portfolio is how little of its return comes from the market.

items.title: Is AbbVie Stock About To Break Out Again?
items.summary: AbbVie's upside case now turns on one pending dosing change for the medicine that supplies close to a third of guided revenue, and management expects it to speed up sales.
